title: CPF Lifetime Retirement Investment Scheme: timing, financial literacy and product design
asked: Mr Shawn Loh asked the Minister for Manpower what considerations guide implementation of the CPF Lifetime Retirement Investment Scheme, accepted in 2016, given that a typical 65% equities and 35% bonds portfolio earned 9.5% per annum over the past five years, and whether delay deprives CPF members of an option to take risks for higher expected returns.
response: The Ministry of Manpower is in the final stages of studying how to provide further support to CPF members to plan for retirement through products balancing risk and return, with updates when ready. Members can already invest CPF savings for potentially higher returns through low-cost funds under the CPF Investment Scheme. In supplementary replies, the Minister said publicity initiatives to educate CPF members will be rolled out when details are finalised, that the objective is to safeguard retirement adequacy, and that the product construct will consider global equities versus bonds and a glide path. He also said guidance was taken from the CPF Advisory Panel and that SGX returns over the last couple of months have been quite impressive.

key_points.point: MOM is in the final stages of studying further support for CPF members to plan retirement through products balancing risk and return.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: the Ministry of Manpower (MOM) is in the final stages of studying how we can provide further support to Central Provident Fund (CPF) members to plan for their retirement through products that would strike the right balance between risk and return.

key_points.point: Members can already invest CPF savings for potentially higher returns through low-cost funds under the CPF Investment Scheme.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: members who wish to invest their CPF savings for potentially higher returns can already do so through a number of low-cost funds under the CPF Investment Scheme.

key_points.point: Publicity initiatives to educate CPF members will be rolled out when details are finalised.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: we will contemporaneously roll out publicity initiatives to educate the broad masses of our CPF members

key_points.point: The objective is to safeguard retirement adequacy.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: the penultimate objective has always been to safeguard retirement adequacy.

key_points.point: Market turbulence means an investor liquidating during a downturn could see a significant drop in asset value, affecting retirement adequacy.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: any investor who had to liquidate his or her investment for retirement needs during a market downturn would have experienced, depending on how long he has been invested for, a significant drop in his asset value and that can impact adversely his retirement adequacy.

key_points.point: Guidance has been taken from the CPF Advisory Panel and features are being studied as markets have evolved.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: We have taken guidance from the CPF Advisory Panel and we are in the process of studying how we can incorporate some of the features

key_points.point: The product construct will consider different weightages on global equities versus bonds.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: The construct of the product will take into account different weightages on global equities versus bonds.

key_points.point: It will also be a glide path depending on when the member enters the product.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: It will also be a glide path, depending on when the member would enter into the particular product that we are looking at.

key_points.point: SGX returns over the last couple of months have been quite impressive.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: over the last couple of months, I think the SGX returns has been quite impressive.

left_open: A specific timeline for the launch or update.
Whether the Lifetime Retirement Investment Scheme specifically remains among the options under final review.
The specific considerations for implementing the scheme.
Whether a locally-directed equity option will be included.
supplementary: Supplementary questions covered financial literacy funding, whether the scheme remains under consideration with a timeline, and a locally-directed equity option.
